features.title: The judge-free axis: does selection anchoring lift an objective metric?
features.description: Every utility number in the paper is a pairwise judged preference, and the judge is dominated by position. GSM8K exact match is not a judge. Both return one of the n draws, so both carry exactly the log n pathwise certificate of Proposition 4 -- which makes self-consistency, the most widely deployed inference-time method there is, a log n-certified NAF mechanism. Baselines k=0 (the n=1 arm) and k=-1 (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct alone, greedy and sampled) on the same problems and seeds. Bands, gate and all four manuscript consequences pre-registered in results/onset_prediction_verifiable.md before generation.

features.title: What the log n certificate delivers when its premise fails
features.description: Proposition 4 bounds an EVENT: Pr_q[E] <= n Pr_{p_s}[E].
